Message:
Btrfs: BUG_ON is deleted from the caller of btrfs_truncate_item & btrfs_extend_item

Currently, btrfs_truncate_item and btrfs_extend_item returns only 0.
So, the check by BUG_ON in the caller is unnecessary.
